title: Set Seedance 2.5 to 16:9 and 30s, and explicitly specify the edit cadence…
content:
Set Seedance 2.5 to 16:9 and 30s, and explicitly specify the edit cadence (exactly 50 rapid cuts) plus cut types (burst cuts, flash cuts) to control pacing.  
Use a reference image as frame one and instruct Seedance to match it exactly to lock the hero asset, environment, reflections, smoke, and color palette across the whole sequence.  
Prevent unwanted elements by adding explicit negatives like Streets stay empty and traffic-free and EXCLUDE: duplicate cars, identity drift, populated streets, traffic, daylight, stopped ending.  
Write a shot-by-shot SEQUENCE with numbered shots and per-shot camera framing + movement (e.g., WS/CU/ECU, locked/pull/push/track/pan/orbit/whip pan/crane) to control cinematography over time.  
Add lens and camera-energy directives (e.g., 18mm energy, active chase cameras) to push dynamic motion and perspective.  
Specify sound design and sync it to edits (cuts strike engine pulses; V8 roar, gear punches, tire scrub, water hits, exhaust cracks, street reverb) to guide audio generation/selection.  
For a strong first-frame anchor, generate the frame-one reference in Midjourney with --ar 16:9, a fixed --seed, and style controls like --stylize 250 and --chaos 8 to get a consistent composition Seedance can follow.

es.content:
Configura Seedance 2.5 en 16:9 y 30 s, y especifica explícitamente la cadencia de edición (exactamente 50 cortes rápidos) junto con los tipos de corte (burst cuts, flash cuts) para controlar el ritmo.  
Usa una imagen de referencia como primer frame e indica a Seedance que la iguale exactamente para fijar el hero asset, el entorno, los reflejos, el humo y la paleta de color en toda la secuencia.  
Evita elementos no deseados añadiendo negativos explícitos como Streets stay empty and traffic-free y EXCLUDE: duplicate cars, identity drift, populated streets, traffic, daylight, stopped ending.  
Escribe una SEQUENCE plano por plano con planos numerados y encuadre + movimiento de cámara por plano (p. ej., WS/CU/ECU, locked/pull/push/track/pan/orbit/whip pan/crane) para controlar la cinematografía a lo largo del tiempo.  
Añade directrices de lente y energía de cámara (p. ej., 18mm energy, active chase cameras) para potenciar el movimiento dinámico y la perspectiva.  
Especifica el diseño sonoro y sincronízalo con los cortes (cuts strike engine pulses; V8 roar, gear punches, tire scrub, water hits, exhaust cracks, street reverb) para guiar la generación/selección de audio.  
Para un anclaje fuerte del primer frame, genera la referencia del frame uno en Midjourney con --ar 16:9, un --seed fijo y controles de estilo como --stylize 250 y --chaos 8 para obtener una composición consistente que Seedance pueda seguir.

fr.content:
Réglez Seedance 2.5 sur 16:9 et 30 s, et précisez explicitement la cadence de montage (exactement 50 cuts rapides) ainsi que les types de cuts (burst cuts, flash cuts) pour contrôler le rythme.  
Utilisez une image de référence comme première frame et demandez à Seedance de la reproduire exactement afin de verrouiller l’asset principal, l’environnement, les reflets, la fumée et la palette de couleurs sur toute la séquence.  
Évitez les éléments indésirables en ajoutant des négatifs explicites comme Streets stay empty and traffic-free et EXCLUDE: duplicate cars, identity drift, populated streets, traffic, daylight, stopped ending.  
Rédigez une SEQUENCE plan par plan avec des plans numérotés et, pour chaque plan, le cadrage + le mouvement de caméra (par ex. WS/CU/ECU, locked/pull/push/track/pan/orbit/whip pan/crane) afin de contrôler la cinématographie dans le temps.  
Ajoutez des directives sur l’objectif et l’énergie caméra (par ex. 18mm energy, active chase cameras) pour accentuer le mouvement dynamique et la perspective.  
Précisez le sound design et synchronisez-le avec les cuts (cuts strike engine pulses; V8 roar, gear punches, tire scrub, water hits, exhaust cracks, street reverb) pour guider la génération/sélection audio.  
Pour un ancrage fort de la première frame, générez la référence de la frame one dans Midjourney avec --ar 16:9, un --seed fixe, et des contrôles de style comme --stylize 250 et --chaos 8 afin d’obtenir une composition cohérente que Seedance peut suivre.

ja.content:
Seedance 2.5 を 16:9 と 30s に設定し、編集のカデンス（ちょうど 50 回の高速カット）とカットタイプ（burst cuts、flash cuts）を明示的に指定して、テンポをコントロールします。  
参照画像をフレーム1として使用し、Seedance にそれを正確に一致させるよう指示して、ヒーローアセット、環境、反射、煙、カラーパレットをシーケンス全体で固定します。  
不要な要素を防ぐために、Streets stay empty and traffic-free や EXCLUDE: duplicate cars, identity drift, populated streets, traffic, daylight, stopped ending のような明示的なネガティブ指定を追加します。  
番号付きショットと、各ショットごとのカメラの画角 + 動き（例: WS/CU/ECU、locked/pull/push/track/pan/orbit/whip pan/crane）を含む shot-by-shot の SEQUENCE を記述し、時間経過に伴うシネマトグラフィーをコントロールします。  
レンズと camera-energy の指示（例: 18mm energy、active chase cameras）を追加して、ダイナミックな動きとパースを強調します。  
サウンドデザインを指定し、編集に同期させます（cuts strike engine pulses; V8 roar, gear punches, tire scrub, water hits, exhaust cracks, street reverb）ことで、音声生成／選定を導きます。  
強力なファーストフレームのアンカーとして、Midjourney でフレーム1の参照画像を --ar 16:9、固定の --seed、さらに --stylize 250 や --chaos 8 のようなスタイル制御付きで生成し、Seedance が追従できる一貫した構図を得ます。

ko.content:
Seedance 2.5를 16:9와 30초로 설정하고, 편집 cadence를 명시적으로 지정하세요(정확히 50개의 rapid cuts)와 cut types(burst cuts, flash cuts)를 함께 넣어 페이싱을 제어합니다.  
reference image를 frame one으로 사용하고, Seedance가 이를 정확히 일치시키도록 지시해 hero asset, environment, reflections, smoke, color palette가 전체 시퀀스에서 고정되게 합니다.  
원치 않는 요소를 막기 위해 Streets stay empty and traffic-free와 EXCLUDE: duplicate cars, identity drift, populated streets, traffic, daylight, stopped ending 같은 명시적 negatives를 추가하세요.  
숏별로 번호를 매긴 SEQUENCE를 작성하고, 각 shot마다 camera framing + movement를 넣으세요(예: WS/CU/ECU, locked/pull/push/track/pan/orbit/whip pan/crane) ताकि 시간에 따른 cinematography를 제어할 수 있습니다.  
lens와 camera-energy 지시도 추가하세요(예: 18mm energy, active chase cameras) ताकि dynamic motion과 perspective를 더 강하게 밀어붙일 수 있습니다.  
sound design을 지정하고 이를 edits에 맞춰 동기화하세요(cuts strike engine pulses; V8 roar, gear punches, tire scrub, water hits, exhaust cracks, street reverb) ताकि audio generation/selection을 안내할 수 있습니다.  
강력한 first-frame anchor를 위해 Midjourney에서 frame-one reference를 생성할 때 --ar 16:9, 고정된 --seed, 그리고 --stylize 250, --chaos 8 같은 style controls를 사용해 Seedance가 따라갈 수 있는 일관된 구도를 얻으세요.

pt.content:
Defina o Seedance 2.5 para 16:9 e 30s, e especifique explicitamente a cadência de edição (exatamente 50 cortes rápidos) além dos tipos de corte (burst cuts, flash cuts) para controlar o ritmo.  
Use uma imagem de referência como o primeiro frame e instrua o Seedance a reproduzi-la exatamente para travar o hero asset, o ambiente, os reflexos, a fumaça e a paleta de cores em toda a sequência.  
Evite elementos indesejados adicionando negativos explícitos como Streets stay empty and traffic-free e EXCLUDE: duplicate cars, identity drift, populated streets, traffic, daylight, stopped ending.  
Escreva uma SEQUENCE shot-by-shot com shots numerados e, para cada shot, enquadramento + movimento de câmera (por exemplo, WS/CU/ECU, locked/pull/push/track/pan/orbit/whip pan/crane) para controlar a cinematografia ao longo do tempo.  
Adicione diretrizes de lente e energia de câmera (por exemplo, 18mm energy, active chase cameras) para intensificar o movimento dinâmico e a perspectiva.  
Especifique o sound design e sincronize-o com as edições (cuts strike engine pulses; V8 roar, gear punches, tire scrub, water hits, exhaust cracks, street reverb) para orientar a geração/seleção de áudio.  
Para uma âncora forte no primeiro frame, gere a referência do frame um no Midjourney com --ar 16:9, um --seed fixo e controles de estilo como --stylize 250 e --chaos 8 para obter uma composição consistente que o Seedance possa seguir.

zh.content:
将 Seedance 2.5 设置为 16:9 和 30s，并明确指定剪辑节奏（恰好 50 个快速切）以及切换类型（burst cuts、flash cuts），以控制节奏。  
使用参考图像作为第一帧，并指示 Seedance 精确匹配它，以锁定整个序列中的主角资产、环境、反射、烟雾和色彩调色板。  
通过添加明确的负面约束来防止不需要的元素，例如 Streets stay empty and traffic-free 和 EXCLUDE: duplicate cars, identity drift, populated streets, traffic, daylight, stopped ending。  
编写一个逐镜头的 SEQUENCE，使用编号镜头以及每个镜头的画面构图 + 运镜（例如 WS/CU/ECU、locked/pull/push/track/pan/orbit/whip pan/crane），以控制随时间变化的摄影语言。  
加入镜头和 camera-energy 指令（例如 18mm energy、active chase cameras），以增强动态运动和透视感。  
指定 sound design，并将其与剪辑同步（cuts strike engine pulses；V8 roar, gear punches, tire scrub, water hits, exhaust cracks, street reverb），以指导音频生成/选择。  
为了获得强有力的首帧锚点，可在 Midjourney 中生成第一帧参考图，使用 --ar 16:9、固定的 --seed，以及 --stylize 250 和 --chaos 8 等风格控制，以获得 Seedance 可以跟随的一致构图。
